resources.string: Add what you actually have. Every ingredient counts.

Your pantry is empty. Add an ingredient above, or load the optional sample pantry in Settings.
Remove %1$s from your pantry? You cannot undo this.
Could not save. Please try again.
Keep track of a single batch. Add another batch when its expiry date is different.
Use piece for eggs, tomatoes and individual vegetables; slice for bread; g or kg for dry food; ml or l for liquids.
1 kg = 1,000 g · 1 l = 1,000 ml\n1 tsp = 5 ml · 1 tbsp = 15 ml · 1 cup = 250 ml\nMass and volume are never treated as interchangeable.
Enter an ingredient name containing letters.
Use a real date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-12-01.
Only complete matches appear here. Missing ingredients, insufficient quantities and expired batches are excluded.
Add the ingredients you have, with the right quantities and units. We never assume you have salt, oil or water.
You have every ingredient for this recipe.
Your pantry changed. This recipe is no longer a complete match.
Amounts make one small batch. Each suggestion is checked independently; cooking does not automatically deduct stock. Update your pantry after cooking.
Highlights items due within 3 days while you use the app. Expired batches are always excluded from matching. This is an in-app reminder, with no background notifications.
An optional set of 9 ingredient batches lets you explore matching. It can only be loaded into an empty pantry.
The sample needs an empty pantry. Your current ingredients were kept.
Add 9 sample ingredient batches? These are demonstration quantities, so replace them with your real stock before using the app.
Sample pantry loaded. Open Recipes to see complete matches.
Permanently delete every pantry batch? Your 20 recipe records will be kept.

Smart Pantry Manager · Version 1.0
Java + XML · SQLite
20 recipes, stored on your device.
No account, internet connection or location access is needed to use the app.

Names ignore case and extra spaces, and common plurals such as tomatoes and eggs are supported.

Compatible batches are added together. Pieces and slices stay separate.

Choose the unit used by the ingredient list; no density or vegetable-weight assumptions are made.

The date is your entered tracking date, not a guarantee that food is safe to eat.
